name: OVER_{mass}_t_WHITE_LONG
notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. The sheet's two edge figures are the white edge and edge + black border (6 / 18 = edge 6 + border 12), as the AS 1743 drawings. Sheet R9-SA106 (1:15): R9-SA106C 1800 x 1050 illustrated (B 1200 x 700 also; register lists B first, PNG R9-SA106B.png), R150, 24 / 72 (edge 24 + border 48). OVER 240 E, baseline 455 (top 215), ink 919 (440/919/441). Line 2 baseline 835 (455 + 380): mass numerals 240 E ('Varies', dashed box) then 100 gap and lower-case t '200 E(lc)' 92 wide, the line centred ('=' both sides). The t is Series E lower case at cap height 200 (the FHWA Series E t at 200 is 92 wide, as the sheet states); its baseline is the numerals' baseline. The sheet gives no example mass: generated at 4.5, 8, 12, 15 and 22.5 t (gross-mass thresholds used on Australian load-limit plates; not confirmed against SA practice — add or drop values as needed). Only with R6-28; TASS to be contacted before use.
